summary: Admins can read a clear, read-only map of who may do what; Super admin leftovers are cleaned from current docs and the wiki; access tests and 403 pages stay consistent for every gate and policy.
detailed_changes: Admin → Roles and permissions (/admin/permissions) shows Public, Staff and Admin descriptions and a read-only ability matrix that matches the policies and gates in code (#817).
User-facing docs, README roadmap and the staff wiki Roles and Roadmap pages no longer suggest Super admin is a live Newsroom role; historic plans get a short footnote only (#816).

AuthzGatesCatalogueTest documents every named gate and policy class with its covering Feature test, and asserts staff 403s use Errors/Panel, public 403s use Errors/Show, and guests are redirected to login rather than a 500 (#818).
Change Log Hub entry for this release (#819).
affected_areas: Page or route: /admin/permissions, staff wiki Roles and access, Roadmap
User groups affected: admins (new matrix); staff (unchanged access, clearer 403 copy when opening admin pages)
Internal impact: clearer role documentation and stronger access tests
